whatThisPluginAdds.text: Theme Agency provides a Blade presentation for curated portfolios, creator profiles, winner labels, taxonomy filters, resources, and newsletter sections.

surfaceOutcome.text: Admins select Agency through theme management, preview it, and adjust shared theme settings. Public pages use its portfolio-focused presets and package-owned widgets.

developers.text: The provider extends the Foundation default theme and registers Agency definitions, presets, assets, and layout-widget renderables through shared registries.

teams.text: Portfolio and design-education teams get a recognition-led public structure while editors keep their normal Capell content workflow.
